name: Latin Leap — Apify Scraping Steps
description: Add these steps to your Pipedream workflow BEFORE merge_sources. Each step scrapes a different source.

steps.note: Scrape YC companies via Apify actor. Apify Actor: https://apify.com/epctex/y-combinator-scraper
Scrape LinkedIn company search for LATAM startups. Apify Actor: https://apify.com/curious_coder/linkedin-company-search-scraper
Scrape public accelerator portfolios. Apify Actor: https://apify.com/apify/web-scraper

steps.cost: requiere plan Crunchbase Pro (~$29/mes) o Apify actor
steps.note: Scrape Crunchbase for recent LATAM funding rounds. Apify Actor: https://apify.com/ontopo/crunchbase-companies-scraper
Replace your existing merge_sources step with this one

setup.1_apify_account: Crea cuenta en apify.com (free tier incluye $5 creditos/mes)
setup.2_apify_token: En Apify: Settings > Integrations > API Token — copialo
setup.3_add_secret: En Pipedream agrega secret: apify_token con tu token de Apify
setup.4_replace_steps: Reemplaza fetch_yc y merge_sources de tu workflow anterior con estos pasos nuevos
setup.5_add_steps: Agrega fetch_linkedin, fetch_500latam, fetch_crunchbase como steps nuevos antes de merge_sources
setup.6_order: Orden correcto: fetch_yc > fetch_linkedin > fetch_500latam > fetch_crunchbase > merge_sources > score_with_claude > filter_by_threshold > send_telegram

costs.apify_free_tier: $5 USD creditos/mes — suficiente para ~500 scrapes diarios
